messages:
riley: quick check — ran twin-pass prefetch runs against llama3-12b-quant on nightly. seeing periodic token-level latency spikes + tiny QA regressions. attaching short logs and eval numbers. need quick ops + decode-research triage.

akiko: run details: 2000 samples, avg seq 256, batching target 8, warmup_window=64. baseline p/token ~11.8ms, spikes to ~240ms at tails. quality: EM 87.2 -> 86.6 on squad-like eval. hypothesis: KV warmup + late small batches. :thinking:

ben: can you paste the spike trace? also what's the CPU/GPU utilization during spikes?

akiko: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-10T02:14:03Z] batch_id=4321 batch_size=3 step=120 prefetch_wait_ms=215 p99_token_ms=238
[2026-03-10T02:14:04Z] batch_id=4322 batch_size=8 step=121 prefetch_wait_ms=8 p99_token_ms=12
```
GPU util hovered 60-85%, no mem OOMs. spikes correlate with batches of 1 or 3.

lee: infra note: we've seen tail batches form when routing policy sends single long-context requests into warm pools. scheduler traces show backfills causing small batches for ~2% of requests.

ben: quick config tweak to test:
```
serve:
  warmup_window: 32
  max_batch_delay_ms: 4
  min_batch_size: 4
```
Try that locally with the same mix and see if spikes disappear.

akiko: re-ran with warmup_window=32 + min_batch_size=4: p99_token_ms reduced to ~32ms, EM drop narrower: 87.0 -> 86.8 (within noise). early impressions: shorter warmup reduces KV miss tail but may slightly affect very long-context coherence.

ops-bot: deploy-note: scaling tweak applied to nightly cluster (min_batch_size=4) at 2026-03-10T03:01:00Z :rocket:

riley: action items: (1) akiko to run a longer 10k-sample eval with the new config and collect per-length EM. (2) ben/lee to add tracing to routing path to capture batch sizes distribution. (3) if EM delta stays <0.4, roll config to canary. tagging @ben @lee @akiko. thanks :thumbsup:
